rationale: C02 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both are Senate-directed letters opposing House-added restrictions in an appropriations bill; each opens with presidential concern, identifies an arbitrary House limitation, explains the damaging consequences if it stands, urges removal of the restriction and restoration of requested funds, predicts congressional agreement once the facts are understood, and closes by offering information from the responsible administrator. C17 and C10 share the appropriations-restoration function, but their phrasing and overall progression are less closely aligned.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am gravely concerned about an item of very special significance in H.R. 4740... Yet the House of Representatives... cut ten per cent... In addition, the House inserted a proviso
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am deeply concerned about the crippling limitation on the public housing program which the House included in H.R. 3880
shared_material.explanation: Both introduce a specific House-imposed restriction in an appropriations bill through nearly parallel expressions of presidential concern.

shared_material.child_excerpt: These actions by the House, if allowed to stand, would force this Government to default on its obligations
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Yet under the House bill, construction of new projects will be virtually halted... If the limitations of the House bill are allowed to stand, virtually none of them could be built next year.
shared_material.explanation: Each frames the House provision as producing a severe practical consequence if allowed to stand.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I want to urge as strongly as I can that the Senate restore the needed funds and eliminate the restrictive proviso added by the House.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I earnestly hope the limitation can be removed before the Congress completes action on this bill... the public housing limitations... should be removed and the funds requested in the budget restored
shared_material.explanation: The central request uses the same two-part machinery: remove the House restriction and restore the necessary funds.

shared_material.child_excerpt: When the facts in this case are fully appreciated and understood, I am confident that the Congress will provide the full amount... and will steer clear of any rigid limitation
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I feel sure that when all these facts are taken into account, the Congress will agree that the public housing limitations... should be removed and the funds requested... restored
shared_material.explanation: The concluding confidence formula and requested legislative result are strongly parallel.

shared_material.child_excerpt: If your Committee desires any further information... Secretary Acheson and Ambassador Austin will be glad to supply it right away.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Housing and Home Finance Administrator has a complete report... He will be glad to make this available to you.
shared_material.explanation: Both close the substantive case by offering committee access to supporting information from the responsible officials.
